Guidance for Claude Code. MVP demo; prefer simple, readable and composable code. Backend ASP.NET Core 10 minimal APIs/EF Core (`src/BudgetTracker.Api/`, `Auth/`, `AntiForgery/`); frontend React 18 TypeScript strict/Vite/Tailwind/React Router v7/Axios. Identity cookies + Static API keys; conditional anti-forgery; database query user isolation; CSV import; Azure OpenAI; pgvector; background AI; NLP. Keys via `StaticApiKeysConfiguration`. Clear names over generic names like Repository, Service, Manager, etc. Avoid using comments to overexplain everything. No code comments - use descriptive method/class names instead.

Microsoft Testing Platform (not VSTest); snake_case: `Should_do_when_something`; Testcontainers; NSubstitute preferred.

dotnet watch run
dotnet run -p tests/BudgetTracker.Api.Tests --output detailed --filter-query "/path/to/test"
dotnet ef migrations add MigrationName
dotnet ef database update
npm run dev
npm run build
npm run lint
docker compose up -d
docker compose down

`Host=localhost;Port=5432;Database=budgettracker;Username=budgetuser;Password=budgetpass123`; API http://localhost:5295, frontend http://localhost:5173, Swagger http://localhost:5295/swagger; CORS ports 5295/5173. When one of the applications is started for testing, make sure it's stopped once finished.
